Install in three steps

  1. Download the APK on your Android phone.
  2. Open the download. If Android asks, allow this browser or file manager to install this app.
  3. Tap Install, then open L.B. Smith Parts.

The catalog ships inside the app. Source links open in your browser when connected. Notes, saved parts and jobs and selected parts remain on your device. Use Import & export → Back up my workspace before changing phones or reinstalling.

From base number to service part

Round 3 adds guided catalog dropdowns and readable service-part cards. Sign into your Snap-on account once on the phone, then use Find parts and the app menus to select a location, illustration and service number. EPC and new VIN decodes need internet. Changing the VIN flags earlier selections for rechecking.

Updating the app

Back up your workspace, then install this APK over the existing app. Keep the existing app installed to preserve its local data.

Use it in your browser

The same workspace works on a desktop, tablet or phone. Browser bookmarks and notes are separate from the Android app.

Open parts workspace ↗

Base numbers identify part families, not exact vehicle fitment. Confirm the full service part by VIN. Coverage is broad but incomplete.
